title: embarko.json
description: Optional settings file in the app's top folder (next to package.json). Embarko reads it on every deploy. Never put secrets here: it is part of the code. Guide: https://embarko.ai/docs/embarko-json

appId.description: The app this code deploys to: app.id from the first deploy reply. Keeps reaching the same app after it is renamed. Guide: https://embarko.ai/docs/embarko-json

schedules.description: The app's full set of timed calls, matched by path. [] removes all. Leave the key out to keep the schedules as they are. Guide: https://embarko.ai/docs/schedules

cron.description: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5". @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly and @yearly also work. At most once every 5 minutes.

path.description: The route of the app to call with GET, starting with /. One schedule per path.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, such as Asia/Kolkata or Europe/London.

name.description: Optional label, shown in failure alerts.
